s: NIKI party participated in protests during the 90th Thessaloniki International Fair, criticizing the Mitsotakis government's policies on agriculture, family support, education, and economic measures.

q.o: Είμαστε στη Διεθνή Έκθεση Θεσσαλονίκης για τον αγώνα του λαού μας απέναντι στην καταστροφική κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη.
q.t: We are at the Thessaloniki International Fair for our people's struggle against the catastrophic Mitsotakis government.

q.o: Ο πρωθυπουργός της χώρας και η κυβέρνησή του έχουν αποδείξει ότι στρέφονται απέναντι σε οτιδήποτε ελληνικό, ορθόδοξο και εθνικό.
q.t: The country's prime minister and his government have proven that they turn against anything Greek, Orthodox and national.

q.o: Όταν ο πρωθυπουργός της χώρας χρειάζεται να βρίσκεται μέσα σε μία γυάλα, την οποία περιφρουρούν 3.500 αστυνομικοί, αυτό σημαίνει ότι έχει χάσει κάθε πραγματική επαφή με τον λαό.
q.t: When the country's prime minister needs to be inside a glass bubble, guarded by 3,500 police officers, this means he has lost all real contact with the people.

s: NIKI party criticizes the Greek government's procurement of the Israeli "Shield of Achilles" air defense system, questioning whether Greece will have full operational control or remain dependent on Israel for access to source code and system operation.

q.o: Ο κ. Πατέλ δήλωσε ξεκάθαρα ότι η Ελλάδα δεν θα έχει πρόσβαση στον πηγαίο κώδικα του συστήματος Command & Control, καθώς αυτός δεν περιλαμβάνεται στην άδεια χρήσης, προσθέτοντας ότι το Ισραήλ θα βρίσκεται δίπλα μας για υποστήριξη και συντήρηση.
q.t: Mr. Patel stated clearly that Greece will not have access to the source code of the Command & Control system, as this is not included in the license, adding that Israel will be beside us for support and maintenance.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ ξεκαθαρίζει ότι στην άμυνα της πατρίδας δεν χωρούν εξαρτήσεις, αστερίσκοι και «άδειες χρήσης» που αφήνουν κρίσιμες δυνατότητες στα χέρια τρίτων.
q.t: NIKI clarifies that in the defense of the homeland there is no room for dependencies, asterisks and 'licenses' that leave critical capabilities in the hands of third parties.

s: The Alternative für Deutschland achieved a historic result in the Saxony-Anhalt regional elections in September 2026.
Ulrich Siegmund led the Alternative für Deutschland to a historic electoral victory in Saxony-Anhalt.
Alternative für Deutschland thanked Elon Musk following a state election win that prompted warnings from France.
The AfD achieved a significant electoral victory in eastern Germany but did not secure a majority.
Jordan Bardella's European tour encountered controversy over his positions on immigration and Ukraine.
Jordan Bardella expressed unease about Marine Le Pen's election platform positions on headscarves and pensions within the Rassemblement National party.
Rassemblement National leader Jordan Bardella and UK politician Nigel Farage have formed a pact on small boats migration policy that has drawn criticism in France.
Jordan Bardella publicly expressed support for British far-right politician Nigel Farage who is facing political difficulties.
A La France Insoumise candidate received death and rape threats due to her support for Palestine.

FPÖ education spokesman Hermann Brückl criticized NEOS Education Minister Christoph Wiederkehr for abolishing mandatory German language support classes while simultaneously expressing concern about declining reading skills among Austrian students.

q.o: Herr Minister, wer sinnerfassendes Lesen zu Recht als Grundvoraussetzung für ein selbstbestimmtes Leben bezeichnet, kann nicht gleichzeitig die gezielte Deutschförderung aufweichen und das dann auch noch als Erfolg verkaufen.
q.t: Mr. Minister, whoever rightly describes reading comprehension as a basic prerequisite for a self-determined life cannot simultaneously weaken targeted German language support and then sell that as a success.

q.o: Erst Deutsch, dann Schule, denn ohne ausreichende Sprachkenntnisse wird jedes weitere Bildungsversprechen zur Luftnummer.
q.t: First German, then school, because without sufficient language skills every further educational promise becomes empty air.

s: The FPÖ criticizes the ÖVP for rejecting FPÖ proposals to ban political Islam since 2020 while now proposing similar measures, and accuses the ÖVP of enabling mass Muslim immigration and funding deradicalization programs allegedly linked to the Muslim Brotherhood.

q.o: Um die Unglaubwürdigkeit von Stockers plötzlicher Forderung zu entlarven, braucht man sich nur zwei Fragen stellen: Wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass es bis heute kein Verbotsgesetz gegen den politischen Islam gibt? Und wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass wir ein solches Verbotsgesetz überhaupt brauchen, weil der radikale Islamismus die Sicherheit der Menschen in unserem Land bedroht? In beiden Fällen lautet die Antwort: Die ÖVP!
q.t: To expose the incredibility of Stocker's sudden demand, one only needs to ask two questions: Who bears responsibility for the fact that there is still no ban law against political Islam today? And who bears responsibility for the fact that we need such a ban law at all, because radical Islamism threatens the security of people in our country? In both cases the answer is: The ÖVP!

q.o: Damit steht der Verdacht im Raum, dass mit öffentlichem Geld genau jene Entwicklung begünstigt worden sein könnte, die eigentlich verhindert werden sollte. Das muss bis auf den letzten Cent und bis zur letzten Entscheidung aufgeklärt werden
q.t: This raises the suspicion that public money may have been used to promote exactly the development that was supposed to be prevented. This must be clarified down to the last cent and to the last decision

q.o: Wenn die fachliche und pädagogische Qualifikation, die an einer österreichischen Universität erworben wurde, in den Hintergrund rückt und stattdessen die Frage des Kopftuchs zum zentralen Thema eines Bewerbungsgesprächs wird, dann läuft hier etwas grundlegend falsch
q.t: If the professional and pedagogical qualifications acquired at an Austrian university take a back seat and instead the question of the headscarf becomes the central topic of a job interview, then something is fundamentally wrong here

s: Sweden Democrats released their 2026 election campaign film featuring party leader Jimmie Åkesson reflecting on Sweden's changing security situation and his political journey to restore what he describes as a safe and confident Sweden.

q.o: För problemen i vårt land har skapats av dålig politik, som har skapats av dåliga politiker. Och för att få förändring, förändring på riktigt, behöver man också på riktigt byta ut dåliga politiker.
q.t: Because the problems in our country have been created by bad politics, which has been created by bad politicians. And to get change, real change, you also really need to replace bad politicians.

q.o: Jag har blivit hatad, förlöjligad, hånad och utfryst. Nej, det finns inget med min resa som varit särskilt enkelt, men jag tog mig fram, in till maktens centrum för att, för att berätta för dem, hur de förstört vårt land.
q.t: I have been hated, ridiculed, mocked and frozen out. No, there is nothing about my journey that has been particularly easy, but I made my way forward, into the center of power to, to tell them, how they destroyed our country.

q.o: För nu händer det saker. För första gången på väldigt länge börjar saker på riktigt bli bättre.
q.t: Because now things are happening. For the first time in a very long time, things are really starting to get better.

s: Santiago Abascal of Vox commented on the AfD's victory in Saxony-Anhalt, calling it a great hope for Germany and Europe.

q.o: una gran esperanza para Alemania y para Europa
q.t: a great hope for Germany and for Europe

s: Jordan Bardella called for examining Morocco's role in Ceuta and urged the PP to align itself with Vox on this issue.
Mónica García criticized PP leader Feijóo and Vox leader Abascal for claiming there is a healthcare collapse in Ceuta, stating that evidence refutes their assertions.
The New York Times reports on the fall of James Orr, described as Nigel Farage's strategist or advisor within Reform UK.
Two senior Reform UK officials resigned amid a foreign donations scandal involving Nigel Farage.
Senior aides to Reform UK leader Nigel Farage resigned following a donation scandal involving an undercover reporter posing as a wealthy American's son.
Investigations have been launched into a polling firm at the centre of allegations involving Reform UK.
Haaretz reports on the composition of Otzma Yehudit's election team, which includes individuals with criminal convictions for terror incitement and a person who killed a Palestinian.
Otzma Yehudit MK Tzvika Foghel announced he will not run on the party ticket in upcoming elections.
National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has frozen planned senior police appointments until after the upcoming election.
Knesset Member Zvi Fogel announced he will not run in the upcoming elections on behalf of Otzma Yehudit party.
Knesset member Tzvika Fogel announced he will not run with Otzma Yehudit party in the upcoming Israeli election.
MK Zvika Fogel announced he will not run in the next election with Otzma Yehudit party.
Israeli ministers from Otzma Yehudit unveiled plans to encourage voluntary Palestinian emigration from Gaza.
Eight Arab and Muslim countries condemned Israeli ministers, including from Otzma Yehudit, over plans for Gaza displacement.
A Hadash candidate is refusing to accept removal from their position following misconduct allegations, and the party will convene to decide the candidate's fate.
Hadash selected a new Knesset candidate following sexual harassment allegations against a previous candidate or member.
Hadash's Jafar Farah withdrew his Knesset candidacy following sexual harassment allegations.
Hadash Knesset candidate Jafar Farah withdrew his candidacy amid harassment allegations.

NIKI party spokesperson Dimos Thanasoulas announced the party will run independently in elections and ruled out coalitions with parties that voted for memoranda or the Prespa Agreement, criticized potential alliances with Maria Karystianou's party over ideological differences on same-sex marriage and digital governance, and rejected any cooperation with former PM Samaras.

q.o: η ΝΙΚΗ κατεβαίνει αυτόνομα, έχει το πρόγραμμά της, έχει τις θεματικές της ομάδες. Είναι ένα κίνημα ευθύνης που διαθέτει συγκεκριμένες προτάσεις και κοστολογημένες θέσεις
q.t: NIKI runs independently, has its own program, has its thematic groups. It is a movement of responsibility that has specific proposals and costed positions

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ, πιστή στις αρχές της, έχει δώσει μεγάλο αγώνα ενάντια στον νόμο για τον γάμο των ομοφυλοφίλων, την ώρα που η πλευρά της κυρίας Καρυστιανού έχει τοποθετηθεί θετικά ή με απάθεια για το ζήτημα
q.t: NIKI, faithful to its principles, has waged a great struggle against the law for same-sex marriage, while Ms. Karystianou's side has positioned itself positively or with indifference on the issue

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ είναι αποτέλεσμα του αγώνα της Μακεδονίας ενάντια στην προδοτική Συμφωνία των Πρεσπών. Αυτό το ζήτημα δεν αποτελεί αντικείμενο διαπραγμάτευσης
q.t: NIKI is the result of Macedonia's struggle against the treasonous Prespa Agreement. This issue is not subject to negotiation

s: NIKI party demands the resignation of Education Minister Sofia Zacharaki and the withdrawal of school textbooks depicting same-sex couples with children, claiming these materials impose an ideological agenda on children.

q.o: Ο Δημήτρης Νατσιός κατήγγειλε από το βήμα της Βουλής, ότι στα νέα βιβλία του Δημοτικού εισάγεται η παρουσίαση ζευγαριών ομοφυλοφίλων με παιδιά ως μορφή οικογένειας.
q.t: Dimitris Natsios denounced from the floor of Parliament that the new elementary school books introduce the presentation of same-sex couples with children as a form of family.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ απαιτεί την άμεση παραίτηση της Σοφίας Ζαχαράκη και την απόσυρση των επίμαχων βιβλίων πριν χτυπήσει το πρώτο κουδούνι σε μία εβδομάδα.
q.t: NIKI demands the immediate resignation of Sofia Zacharaki and the withdrawal of the controversial books before the first bell rings in one week.

q.o: Τα παιδιά μας δεν είναι πειραματόζωα καμίας ιδεολογικής ατζέντας.
q.t: Our children are not guinea pigs of any ideological agenda.

s: MeRA25 issued multiple statements criticizing Greece's military cooperation with Israel and the US, opposing a 3 billion euro deal with Israeli defense industry, the "Shield of Achilles" defense plan, and use of Crete for US-Israel military operations during ongoing conflict.

q.o: Μόνο ντροπή: 3 δισ. στην πολεμική βιομηχανία του γενοκτονικού Ισραήλ
q.t: Only shame: 3 billion to the war industry of genocidal Israel

q.o: Να μη γίνει η Κρήτη στόχος πολέμου – Καμία διευκόλυνση στις επιθετικές επιχειρήσεις ΗΠΑ-Ισραήλ
q.t: Crete must not become a target of war – No facilitation of US-Israel offensive operations

q.o: Η «Ασπίδα του Αχιλλέα» προστατεύει μόνο τα σχέδια του Ισραήλ και των ΗΠΑ – Να παγώσουν τα εξοπλιστικά προγράμματα που χρηματοδοτούν την πολεμική εμπλοκή της Ελλάδας στη Μέση Ανατολή
q.t: The 'Shield of Achilles' only protects the plans of Israel and the USA – Freeze the armament programs that finance Greece's military involvement in the Middle East

s: MeRA25 announces support for a welcome gathering for Aristotelis Chantzis, who ended a 73-day hospitalization following a hunger strike concerning housing rights and the Occupied Prosfygika community.

q.o: Ο Αριστοτέλης Χαντζής μετά από 73 μέρες νοσηλείας, εκ των οποίων οι 58 στη ΜΕΘ, παίρνει εξιτήριο από την πνευμονολογική κλινική του Ευαγγελισμού κι επιστρέφει στη γειτονιά των Προσφυγικών.
q.t: Aristotelis Chantzis, after 73 days of hospitalization, 58 of which in the ICU, is being discharged from the pulmonary clinic of Evangelismos and returns to the Prosfygika neighborhood.

q.o: Η απεργία πείνας του Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή και της Suzon Doppagne αποτελεί μια σημαντική νίκη στον αγώνα για το δικαίωμα στη στέγη.
q.t: The hunger strike of Aristotelis Chantzis and Suzon Doppagne constitutes an important victory in the struggle for the right to housing.

s: MeRA25 condemns the Greek government's active support for what it calls the genocide in Gaza by the state of Israel and calls for participation in a demonstration at the Thessaloniki International Fair on September 5, 2026.

q.o: το άγος που αποτελεί η ενεργή στήριξη της Ελλάδας στη βάρβαρη γενοκτονία που συντελείται εδώ και τρία χρόνια στη Γάζα εναντίον των Παλαιστινίων από το κράτος του Ισραήλ
q.t: the disgrace that constitutes Greece's active support for the barbaric genocide that has been taking place for three years in Gaza against the Palestinians by the state of Israel

q.o: Στην κυριαρχία και ασφάλεια, με απεγκλωβισμό από τον μιλιταριστικό άξονα ΗΠΑ – Ισραήλ και σεβασμό στο διεθνές ανθρωπιστικό δίκαιο
q.t: In sovereignty and security, with disengagement from the militaristic US-Israel axis and respect for international humanitarian law

q.o: Στον ειρηνευτικό ρόλο και την επιρροή, με ανάληψη πρωτοβουλιών για τερματισμό της Γενοκτονίας
q.t: In the peace role and influence, with initiatives to end the Genocide

s: MeRA25 Enωτική Αριστερά representatives met with the Federation of Professionals and Merchants of Thessaloniki to discuss economic issues including taxation, energy costs, and debt relief for small and medium enterprises.

AfD official Martin Reichardt accuses the German government of ignoring left-extremist terror threats announced for the week after the Saxony-Anhalt state election and claims the danger to democracy comes from the left, not the right.

q.o: Dass Deutschland ein immenses Problem mit gewaltbereiten Linksextremisten hat, ist nüchternen Beobachtern der politischen Lage in Deutschland sattsam bekannt.
q.t: That Germany has an immense problem with violence-ready left-extremists is well known to sober observers of the political situation in Germany.

q.o: Denn die Gefahr für die Demokratie in Deutschland geht eindeutig und vielbewiesenermaßen von links aus!
q.t: For the danger to democracy in Germany clearly and demonstrably comes from the left!

s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticizes the closure of four Volkswagen production sites in Germany, blaming failed economic and energy policy, premature focus on electric mobility, and economic conflicts with Russia and Iran.

q.o: Das Aus für traditionsreiche deutsche Autowerke ist das Resultat einer verfehlten Wirtschafts- und Energiepolitik. Die einseitige und voreilige Fixierung auf Elektromobilität hat die deutsche Schlüsselindustrie in eine Sackgasse geführt. Gleichzeitig zerstören der Wirtschaftskrieg gegen Russland und der Iran-Krieg unsere Versorgung mit bezahlbarer Energie.
q.t: The end for traditional German car factories is the result of failed economic and energy policy. The one-sided and premature fixation on electric mobility has led the German key industry into a dead end. At the same time, the economic war against Russia and the Iran war are destroying our supply of affordable energy.

q.o: Deutschland braucht endlich wieder eine technologieoffene, ausgewogene Industriepolitik, die das Rückgrat unserer Wirtschaft schützt.
q.t: Germany finally needs a technology-open, balanced industrial policy again that protects the backbone of our economy.

s: AfD federal co-leaders Chrupalla and Weidel call the Saxony-Anhalt state election decisive for Germany's future, with lead candidate Ulrich Siegmund polling over 40 percent, emphasizing enforcement of laws on illegal migration and urging supporters to serve as election observers.

q.o: Die AfD Sachsen-Anhalt hat ein klares Ziel für den Wahlsieg formuliert: Sie möchte geltendes Recht – beispielsweise mit Blick auf illegale Migration – durchsetzen und dafür sorgen, dass Deutschland lebenswert bleibt.
q.t: The AfD Saxony-Anhalt has formulated a clear goal for electoral victory: It wants to enforce existing law – for example with regard to illegal migration – and ensure that Germany remains livable.

q.o: Entsprechend ist eine absolute Mehrheit für Ulrich Siegmund und die AfD fast die einzige Chance, das Ruder doch noch herumzureißen.
q.t: Accordingly, an absolute majority for Ulrich Siegmund and the AfD is almost the only chance to turn things around.

s: Churches in Germany are actively opposing the Alternative für Deutschland as the far-right party aims to take power.
Nigel Farage announced an 'entente cordiale' alliance between Reform UK and France's Rassemblement National.
Jordan Bardella of Rassemblement National and Nigel Farage signed a pact regarding Channel migrant crossings.
Rassemblement National pledged to work together with a UK anti-immigration party on Channel crossing issues.
Rassemblement National and Reform UK agreed on a joint plan to stop small boat crossings across the English Channel.
Nigel Farage signed a pact with a French counterpart pledging to stop migrant boat crossings.
Jordan Bardella, a French politician from Rassemblement National, is appearing at a Reform UK conference.

La France insoumise supports Radio France employees who unanimously adopted a motion opposing the appointment of Charles Sapin from Valeurs actuelles and threatens strike action, criticizing what they call far-right infiltration of public broadcasting and promising media reform if elected in 2027.

q.o: Nous ne pouvons que saluer le courage des salarié•es de Radio France, qui défendent ce qui reste de l'honneur du service public de l'audiovisuel.
q.t: We can only salute the courage of Radio France employees, who defend what remains of the honor of public broadcasting service.

q.o: Alors que l'extrême droite progresse partout dans le pays, et que la propagation de son idéologie est accélérée par des médias privés détenus par des patrons réactionnaires, l'audiovisuel public a une responsabilité particulière en matière de lutte contre la diffusion de fausses informations et d'apaisement du débat public.
q.t: While the far right is advancing everywhere in the country, and the spread of its ideology is accelerated by private media owned by reactionary bosses, public broadcasting has a particular responsibility in fighting the spread of false information and calming public debate.

q.o: En 2027, nous changerons tout. Notre première priorité sera de refonder intégralement le fonctionnement des médias publics et privés.
q.t: In 2027, we will change everything. Our first priority will be to completely rebuild the functioning of public and private media.

s: La France insoumise criticizes the Genevard agricultural plan as misdirected, claiming it primarily benefits large agribusiness operations already insured rather than smaller farmers most affected by climate crisis, and fails to address structural issues like price controls or ecological transition.

q.o: Le monde agricole a traversé cet été une crise inédite, subissant en première ligne les conséquences du changement climatique et de l'inaction du Gouvernement.
q.t: The agricultural sector experienced an unprecedented crisis this summer, suffering on the front lines from the consequences of climate change and government inaction.

q.o: La moitié de l'enveloppe ira à des agriculteurs qui sont déjà assurés, c'est-à-dire une minorité. Ceux dont les pertes ne sont pas assurées auprès d'assureurs privés auront beaucoup moins.
q.t: Half of the funding will go to farmers who are already insured, meaning a minority. Those whose losses are not insured with private insurers will receive much less.

q.o: Il est inacceptable que le plan annoncé se fasse au prix d'encore plus d'austérité pour les autres ministères et le reste du pays, à l'heure où les versements de dividendes battent des records.
q.t: It is unacceptable that the announced plan comes at the cost of even more austerity for other ministries and the rest of the country, at a time when dividend payments are breaking records.

s: Jean-Luc Mélenchon expressed regret for his past opposition to Islamic veil wearing.
Marine Le Pen revived proposals for a hijab ban, prompting French women to show online solidarity with Muslims.

FPÖ energy spokesperson Paul Hammerl demands immediate security measures for Austria's gas power plants and energy infrastructure following attacks on German power facilities, criticizing Interior Minister Karner and Energy Minister Hattmannsdorfer for inaction.

q.o: Die Angriffe auf Kraftwerke und Stromleitungen in Deutschland zeigen eine neue Dimension des Terrors im Namen des Klimaschutzes. Wer die Stromversorgung angreift, trifft nicht Energiekonzerne, sondern Millionen Menschen
q.t: The attacks on power plants and power lines in Germany show a new dimension of terror in the name of climate protection. Whoever attacks the power supply does not hit energy corporations, but millions of people

q.o: Zehntausende Menschen saßen tagelang im Kalten und Dunkeln. Familien, Senioren und Pflegebedürftige wurden zu Opfern eines vermeintlichen Kampfes für das Klima
q.t: Tens of thousands of people sat in the cold and dark for days. Families, seniors and those in need of care became victims of a supposed fight for the climate

q.o: Ein Angriff auf unsere Gaskraftwerke, ihre Leitungen oder Umspannwerke wäre ein Angriff auf die Versorgungssicherheit unseres gesamten Landes
q.t: An attack on our gas power plants, their pipelines or substations would be an attack on the security of supply of our entire country

s: FPÖ economic spokesperson Barbara Kolm criticizes the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS coalition government for inaction on the insolvency fund financing gap following critical audit court findings, and warns that climate policies are damaging Austria's economic competitiveness as GDP contracted 0.1 percent in Q2 2026.

q.o: In der anhaltenden Debatte um die Schließung der Finanzierungslücke im Insolvenzentgeltfonds zeigt sich die konzeptionelle Planlosigkeit der schwarz-rot-pinken Regierung. Abgesehen von wohlklingenden Ankündigungen durch ÖVP-Kanzler Stocker und SPÖ-Arbeitsministerin Schumann ist bislang nichts Zählbares passiert
q.t: In the ongoing debate about closing the financing gap in the insolvency fund, the conceptual planlessness of the black-red-pink government is evident. Apart from nice-sounding announcements by ÖVP Chancellor Stocker and SPÖ Labor Minister Schumann, nothing tangible has happened so far

q.o: Vernünftige und verlässliche wirtschaftspolitische Rahmenbedingungen sind die absolute Grundlage für Investitionen, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und sichere Arbeitsplätze. Das sollten sich Kanzler Stocker, Ministerin Schumann und die gesamte schwarz-rot-pinke Regierung dringend in ihr politisches Stammbuch schreiben
q.t: Reasonable and reliable economic policy framework conditions are the absolute foundation for investments, competitiveness and secure jobs. Chancellor Stocker, Minister Schumann and the entire black-red-pink government should urgently write that in their political record book

s: FPÖ foreign policy spokesperson Susanne Fürst criticized Austrian President Van der Bellen's praise of the EU, accusing the union of warmongering, enabling illegal mass immigration that brings violence and crime to European cities, and destroying Austrian prosperity through regulations.

q.o: Europa ist unter dem Diktat der EU-Eliten schon lange nicht mehr sicher. Es ist zu einem Pulverfass geworden, randvoll mit den katastrophalen Folgen der illegalen Massenzuwanderung. Gewalt, importierte Kriminalität und archaische Gesellschaftsvorstellungen prägen mittlerweile den Alltag in unseren Städten.
q.t: Europe under the diktat of EU elites has long ceased to be safe. It has become a powder keg, brimming with the catastrophic consequences of illegal mass immigration. Violence, imported criminality, and archaic social concepts now characterize everyday life in our cities.

q.o: Wir bekennen uns zu Europa, aber die Zukunft liegt nicht in der Unterwerfung unter Brüssel, sondern in einem starken, europäischen Verband der freien und souveränen Vaterländer.
q.t: We commit ourselves to Europe, but the future does not lie in submission to Brussels, but rather in a strong European association of free and sovereign fatherlands.

s: FPÖ criticizes ÖVP's call for EU budget cuts as hypocritical, accusing the governing coalition of planning to abolish Austria's veto right in the EU and demanding that only Herbert Kickl as chancellor can protect Austrian sovereignty.

q.o: Jahrelang hat die ÖVP jede aberwitzige Erhöhung des EU-Molochs mitgetragen und österreichisches Steuergeld mit beiden Händen nach Brüssel transferiert.
q.t: For years the ÖVP has supported every absurd increase of the EU moloch and transferred Austrian tax money to Brussels with both hands.

q.o: Während Frau Ministerin Bauer nun vortäuscht, für eine Kürzung des EU-Budgets zu sein, arbeitet ihre Partei mit dem Rest der Verlierer-Ampel aktiv an der Abschaffung des Einstimmigkeitsprinzips in der EU. Das ist der eigentliche Skandal!
q.t: While Minister Bauer now pretends to be in favor of cutting the EU budget, her party is actively working with the rest of the loser-coalition on abolishing the unanimity principle in the EU. That is the real scandal!

q.o: Nur eine starke FPÖ mit einem Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl ist der Garant dafür, dass die Interessen der Österreicher geschützt, unser Vetorecht verteidigt und dem uferlosen Geldverschleudern an die EU ein für alle Mal ein Riegel vorgeschoben wird.
q.t: Only a strong FPÖ with a people's chancellor Herbert Kickl is the guarantor that the interests of Austrians are protected, our veto right defended, and the boundless squandering of money to the EU is stopped once and for all.

s: FPÖ-Generalsekretär Michael Schnedlitz fordert das Ende der schwarz-rot-pinken Koalitionsregierung und Neuwahlen, kritisiert interne Machtkämpfe in ÖVP und SPÖ um die Ablösung von Bundeskanzler Christian Stocker und SPÖ-Chef Andreas Babler, und wirbt für Herbert Kickl als künftigen Bundeskanzler.

q.o: Das ist längst mehr als das Pfeifen der Spatzen von den Dächern. Aus SPÖ und ÖVP dringt immer offener nach außen, dass man selbst nicht mehr an diese Führung glaubt.
q.t: This is long since more than the chirping of sparrows from the rooftops. From SPÖ and ÖVP it is increasingly openly emerging that they themselves no longer believe in this leadership.

q.o: Stocker und Babler sollen den Weg freimachen – nicht für den nächsten Personaltausch, sondern für Neuwahlen. Dann entscheidet das Volk, und danach kann Österreich unter Herbert Kickl endlich wieder ordentlich geführt werden!
q.t: Stocker and Babler should clear the way – not for the next personnel change, but for new elections. Then the people decide, and after that Austria can finally be properly led again under Herbert Kickl!

s: Sweden Democrats announce they are fielding candidates in all elections across Sweden for the first time in party history, becoming only the second party alongside the Social Democrats to achieve nationwide coverage in 2026.

q.o: Det här är resultatet av ett långsiktigt och målmedvetet arbete i hela vår organisation. Från att ha varit ett litet parti med representation i delar av landet är vi nu ett rikstäckande parti som möter väljarna i varje kommun, varje region och i riksdagsvalet
q.t: This is the result of long-term and purposeful work throughout our organization. From having been a small party with representation in parts of the country, we are now a nationwide party that meets voters in every municipality, every region and in the parliamentary election

q.o: Bakom den här framgången finns tusentals förtroendevalda, kandidater, medlemmar och sverigevänner som har lagt ned ett enormt arbete. Det visar både styrkan och bredden i vårt parti. Sverigedemokraterna finns idag i hela Sverige och vi är redo att ta ansvar i ännu fler kommuner och regioner efter valet
q.t: Behind this success are thousands of elected officials, candidates, members and Sweden-friends who have put in enormous work. It shows both the strength and breadth of our party. The Sweden Democrats are today present throughout Sweden and we are ready to take responsibility in even more municipalities and regions after the election

q.o: Vår ambition är inte bara att finnas med på valsedeln. Vi vill vinna väljarnas förtroende och göra verklig skillnad. Målet är ett starkt valresultat och ett ökat sverigedemokratiskt inflytande i hela landet
q.t: Our ambition is not just to be on the ballot. We want to win voters' trust and make a real difference. The goal is a strong election result and increased Sweden Democrat influence throughout the country

s: The Guardian published a retrospective article about a Black woman's defiance of Swedish neo-Nazis associated with the Nordic Resistance Movement ten years after the incident.

Brothers of Italy officials claim the Meloni government has reduced irregular migration by 55% compared to 2025 and increased repatriations by 34% in the first half of 2026, transforming Lampedusa from an emergency symbol to a tourist destination.

q.o: Per noi sicurezza e immigrazione devono camminare di pari passo. Il governo Meloni ha affrontato il problema dell'immigrazione senza l'ipocrisia di una certa parte politica, che si riempie la bocca di accoglienza, ma poi si dimentica del destino di queste persone una volta sbarcate sulla banchina di un porto.
q.t: For us security and immigration must go hand in hand. The Meloni government has addressed the immigration problem without the hypocrisy of a certain political part, which fills its mouth with welcome, but then forgets the fate of these people once they disembark on the dock of a port.

q.o: Questo governo ha difeso le frontiere, bloccato le partenze e aumentato i rimpatri. -55% di ingressi irregolari nel nostro territorio rispetto al 2025, meno 89% rispetto al 2023. +34% di rimpatri nel primo semestre del 2026
q.t: This government has defended the borders, blocked departures and increased repatriations. -55% of irregular entries into our territory compared to 2025, minus 89% compared to 2023. +34% of repatriations in the first half of 2026

q.o: A Lampedusa c'erano scene di 3000 persone all'interno di un hotspot dimensionato per 300: era la Ceuta italiana.
q.t: In Lampedusa there were scenes of 3000 people inside a hotspot sized for 300: it was the Italian Ceuta.
